title: Grumpy Bookstore Owner
description: Maximize customers by using a technique to keep the owner from being grumpy for a window of k minutes.
pseudocode:
1. satisfied = sum(customers[i] where grumpy[i] == 0)
2. max_additional = 0, curr_additional = 0
3. For i in 0 to k-1: if grumpy[i] == 1, curr_additional += customers[i]
4. max_additional = curr_additional
5. For i in k to n-1:
6.   if grumpy[i] == 1, curr_additional += customers[i]
7.   if grumpy[i-k] == 1, curr_additional -= customers[i-k]
8.   max_additional = max(max_additional, curr_additional)
9. return satisfied + max_additional

steps.note: Calculate base satisfied customers: customers[2] (1) + customers[3] (7) = 8
Initial window [0, 1] (k=2): grumpy indices 0 and 1. Added customers: 1 + 0 = 1
Slide window to [1, 2]: Add customers[2] (grumpy is 1), curr_additional = 1 + 1 = 2
Slide window: Remove customers[0] (grumpy is 1), curr_additional = 2 - 1 = 1
Slide window to [2, 3]: Add customers[3] (grumpy is 0), curr_additional = 1 + 0 = 1
Slide window: Remove customers[1] (grumpy is 0), curr_additional = 1 - 0 = 1
